name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) makes the box pickup happen, and the hard Precedence chain (blocker_moved and has_door_key each before door_open, door_open before target_picked_up) forces the ball, the key, and the door in turn. There is no order between blocker_moved and has_door_key, matching 'in either order', and no redundant Existence or added clause; the machine ends in u6 only after all four events in the required order and rejects any violation.
